brief: Before the user's chat history is deleted, ask them if they're sure.
A screen listing the addresses the user has saved, each opening its own details, with a way to add another address.
Ask the user for their postcode, so the app can find their local council.
Tell the user their local council has been saved, with a way to go on.
In Settings, a setting the user can turn on or off straight away: MOT reminders.
Show GOV.UK Chat answering a question the user asked about renewing their passport.
Explain, in a few paragraphs, what the app does with the user's location, reached from a row in Settings.
Show whether a vehicle's tax and MOT are valid, and how long until each runs out.
Show the vehicle's registration number as it looks on the car itself.
On the driving account screen, let the user switch between their vehicles and their driving licence.
Show a driver's offences and penalty points, side by side, big enough to take in at a glance.
On a vehicle's screen, warn that driving without tax can invalidate the user's insurance.
On a screen of the user's saved addresses, an Edit action for the whole screen.
Show who a vehicle is registered to: their name and postal address.
A journey to add a driver and vehicles account that takes over the app until it's finished or closed.
Over the screen they're on, let the user choose a country from a long list they can filter, then go back.
A prototype that starts from the app's Home screen as users see it today, with one new widget added.
